title: Your Skills Get 1% of the Context Window
caption:
Half my skills never fired and I assumed I'd written them badly.

Claude Code keeps a listing of every skill name and description in context, budgeted at 1% of the model's window. Overflow it and descriptions get dropped, least-invoked first — the skill still exists, it just can't be matched anymore.

/skill-doctor shipped Sept 4 in 2.1.261 and names the ones going unused and what they cost you.

How many skills are you running?

slides.headline:
Skills Take 1%
Of Your Context
slides.sub: Claude Code keeps a listing of every skill name and description in context. Its budget scales at 1% of the model's context window.

slides.title: Overflow Drops Descriptions
slides.sub: When the listing overflows, Claude Code drops descriptions starting with the skills you invoke least — stripping the keywords it needs to match your request.

slides.headline:
1,536 Characters
Per Skill
slides.sub: description plus when_to_use is truncated at 1,536 characters in the listing, no matter how much budget you have. Put the key use case first.

slides.title: New: /skill-doctor
slides.sub: Shipped Sept 4 in Claude Code 2.1.261. Shows which loaded skills go unused and what they cost you in context, so you can prune them.

slides.title: Five Ways To Get It Back
items: SLASH_COMMAND_TOOL_CHAR_BUDGET sets a fixed character count
skillOverrides "name-only" lists a skill without its description
/doctor estimates the listing's cost and its biggest contributors
--debug surfaces the overflow warning from the debug log

slides.headline:
Compaction Drops
Older Skills
slides.sub: After a summary, Claude Code re-attaches each invoked skill: first 5,000 tokens each, 25,000 combined. It fills from the newest, so older skills fall off entirely.
